rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sleepers’ discovery mirrors resurrection: it reveals prepared souls who can receive guidance and recognize bodily resurrection and recompense.
rows.anchor: مثل ذلك البعث والإنامة أطلعنا على حالهم المستعدين القابلين لهديهم ومعرفة حقائقهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One unnamed party says resurrection concerns only immaterial spirits, not bodies.
rows.anchor: فمنهم من يقول: إن البعث مخصوص بالأرواح المجردة دون الأجساد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another party says resurrection joins spirits and bodies; al-Qāshānī endorses this embodied resurrection as the truth.
rows.anchor: ومنهم من يقول: إنه بالأرواح والأجساد معا، فعلموا بالاطلاع عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proposed building resembles lodges, shrines, and visiting places erected over perfected prophets and saints such as Abraham and Muhammad.
rows.anchor: كالخانقاهات والمشاهد والمزارات المبنية على الكمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The followers say God knows the saints best because their rank exceeds other people’s knowledge; they are monotheists annihilated in and realized through God.
rows.anchor: هم أجل وأعظم شأنا من أن يعرفهم غيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A divine saying supports the saints’ hiddenness: only God knows His friends.
rows.anchor: أوليائي تحت قبائي، لا يعرفهم غيري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people with authority over the companions propose a mosque for prayer, seeking blessing through them and their place.
rows.anchor: من أصحابهم والذين يلون أمرهم تبركا بهم وبمكانهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Surface readers among Jews and Muslims speculate about the sleepers’ number; the few who know are verified knowers, and the wording points to seven.
rows.anchor: الظاهريون من أهل الكتاب والمسلمين الذين لا علم لهم بالحقائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The conjunction before the eighth dog signals a quality inseparable from its subject, and the phrase that only a few know confirms seven without a further number.
rows.anchor: وتوسيط الواو الدالة على أن الصفة مجامعة للموصوف ولا تفارقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward reading, the seven sleepers represent the theoretical and practical intellects, thought, estimation, imagination, memory, and common sense; the dog is the lower self, while sun and spirit apply in both readings.
rows.anchor: فهم العاقلتان: النظرية والعملية، والفكر والوهم، والتخيل والذكر

rows.speaker: أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام
rows.claim: A report says the seven comprised three on the king’s right, three on his left, and a seventh shepherd who owned the dog.
rows.anchor: إنهم كانوا سبعة، ثلاثة عن يمين الملك وثلاثة عن يساره، والسابع هو الراعي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If sound, the report maps the king to the commanding self; the right-hand advisers to the two intellects and thought; the left-hand advisers to imagination, estimation, and memory; and the shepherd to common sense over the senses.
rows.anchor: فالملك هو دقيانوس النفس الأمارة، والثلاثة الذين كانوا عن يمينه يستشيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On this reading, the three-count includes the heart and two intellects; the five-count adds thought and estimation but omits common sense and memory as passive repositories.
rows.anchor: والذين قالوا هم ثلاثة ارادوا القلب والعاقلتين، والذين قالوا خمسة زادوا عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward discovery means divine unveiling to realized people that the self survives bodily destruction; the dispute is the faculties’ struggle to control the body in which they will be raised.
rows.anchor: فالاطلاع للفئة المحققين من الحضرة الإلهية على بقاء النفس بعد خراب البدن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The building represents the resurrected body; dominant faculties are its builders, and the mosque signifies animal, natural, and psychic powers submitting within it.
rows.anchor: البنيان المأمور ببنائه والآمرون هم الغالبون الذين قالوا: { لنتخذن عليهم مسجدا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God teaches the Prophet proper courtesy after forbidding disputation: speak of a future act only when God permits or while explicitly attaching it to His will.
rows.anchor: لا تقولن لما عزمت عليه من فعل إني فاعل ذلك في الزمان المستقبل إلا ملتبسا بمشيئة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People should ascribe action to God’s will rather than their own, since they act through Him and His willing.
rows.anchor: لا تسند الفعل إلى إرادتك بل إلى إرادة الله، فتكون فاعلا به وبمشيئته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering God means returning to His presence when heedlessness accompanies the ego’s emergence and shifting qualities.
rows.anchor: بالرجوع إليه والحضور { إذا نسيت } بالغفلة عند ظهور النفس والتلوين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hoped-for better guidance is steadfast self-witnessing, freed from veils of attributes and from fluctuation.
rows.anchor: استقامة، وهو التمكين في الشهود الذاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The three hundred lunar-cycle years amount to twenty-five years, the time until the sleepers awoke; the added nine is the gestation period.
rows.anchor: من التي تبتنى على دور القمر فتكون كل سنة شهرا ومجموعها خمسة وعشرون سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrasing avoids calling the total 309 years: it leaves the counted unit ambiguous because ordinary usage at revelation meant solar years, allowing the unit to be months.
rows.anchor: لم يقل ثلثمائة سنة وتسعا، أو ثلثمائة وتسع سنين، لاستعمال السنة في العرف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The years remain indefinite in the wording; this supports the statement that God knows best how long they stayed.
rows.anchor: ثم بين أن المدة سنين مبهمة غير معينة، إذ لو قيل

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatada says the duration is a continuation of the People of the Book’s reported claim, which the command that God knows best rejects.
rows.anchor: وقال قتادة: هو حكاية كلام أهل الكتاب من تتمة سيقولون: وقوله: { قل الله أعلم } رد عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A version of ʿAbd Allāh’s codex reads “and they said they stayed”; the duration is not certain or consistently established.
rows.anchor: أن اليقين غير محقق ولا مطرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The particle min may mark the source of revelation, with the Book as the first tablet containing all knowledge, or explain what was revealed, with the Book as discriminating intellect.
rows.anchor: يجوز أن تكون من لابتداء الغاية، والكتاب هو اللوح الأول المشتمل على كل العلوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s words that cannot be changed are the foundations of religion: divine unity, justice, and their branches; there is no refuge apart from Him.
rows.anchor: التي هي أصول الدين من التوحيد والعدل وأنواعهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience with God’s people is steadfastness and empowered presence through God, with no attention turned elsewhere.
rows.anchor: أمر بالصبر مع الله وأهله وعدم الالتفات إلى غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those invoking God morning and evening are stripped poor who seek only His essence, without worldly or afterlife needs or fixation on acts and attributes.
rows.anchor: هم الموحدون من الفقراء المجردين الذين لا يطلبون غير الله ولا حاجة لهم في الدنيا والآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Morning and evening signify annihilation and abiding; looking away from these seekers means turning attention toward anything other than God.
rows.anchor: وقت احتجابها بهم عند البقاء، فالصبر معهم هو الصبر مع الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers are polytheists veiled from truth; their surrounding fire is the enclosing realm of material natures and forms.
rows.anchor: أي: المشركين المحجوبين عن الحق لقوله:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The scalding drink is variously interpreted as foul, blackened, fatty runoff from the damned, their dirty washings, or burning anguish and distress.
rows.anchor: المياه المتعفنة التي تسيل من أبدان أهل النار مسودة فيها دسومات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True intellectual or witnessed faith and purifying deeds prepare the self to receive manifestations of divine attributes by shedding its own qualities.
rows.anchor: الإيمان الحقيقي العلمي أو العيني { وعملوا الصالحات } من الأعمال المزكية المصفية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promised love is the effect of an initial divine election: God first loves in hiddenness, then that love moves the servant to renew the primordial covenant through following the Beloved.
rows.anchor: هذا الود أثر ونتيجة العناية الأولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Following God in works and states brings a further love of choosing, beyond the first hidden love, and acceptance among people of innate faith.
rows.anchor: وإن صحت المتابعة في الأعمال والأحوال أحبه الله بمحبة الاصطفاء فوق المحبة

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: A report says that when God loves a servant, He tells Gabriel, who loves the person and announces this to heaven, after which God places love for the person on earth.
rows.anchor: وعن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " إذا أحب الله عبدا يقول الله تعالى:

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatada says that when a servant turns toward God, God turns the hearts of other people toward that servant.
rows.anchor: ما أقبل عبد إلى الله إلا أقبل الله بقلوب العباد إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A prior decree prevents this community’s destruction in worldly life because its Prophet is a prophet of mercy; otherwise annihilation would follow, as the cited verse says.
rows.anchor: قضاء سابق أن لا يستأصل هذه الأمة بالدمار والعذاب في الدنيا لكون نبيهم نبي الرحمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should be patient through God, since his opponents are governed by what God decreed and remain captive to divine power.
rows.anchor: فإنك تراهم جارين على ما قضى الله عليهم، مأسورين في أسر قهره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorification strips the self of its own qualities while it bears the Lord’s qualities; this manifestation is true praise.
rows.anchor: نزه ذاتك بتجريدها عن صفاتها متلبسا بصفات ربك، فإن ظهورها عليك هو الحمد الحقيقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before sunrise and sunset mark the spirit’s disclosure and concealment in the heart’s station; glorifying there erases the heart’s qualities.
rows.anchor: في مقام القلب حال تجلي الصفات، فإن تسبيح الله هناك محو صفات القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night spells are the ego’s dark, veiling shifts, while day’s edges are the spirit illuminating the heart; purification and refinement lead toward contentment.
rows.anchor: أي: أوقات غلبات صفات النفس المظلمة والتلوينات الحاجبة

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the people forget the interval of torment between the two trumpet blasts, during their concealment in the barzakh.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عباس: أنساهم ما كانوا فيه من العذاب بين النفختين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They call the stay brief because it has ended; God affirms it was brief, and knowing this would have led them to prepare and detach from its pleasures.
rows.anchor: وإنما استقصروها لانقضائها وكل منقض فهو ليس بشي، ولهذا صدقهم بقوله: { إن لبثتم إلا قليلا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plea for forgiveness concerns the forms of attachment, while mercy means the bestowal of perfections.
rows.anchor: هيئات المعلقات { وارحم } بإفاضة الكمالات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Clouds signify branches of intellect drawn from particular images by inspirations and volitions, then combined into syllogistic arrangements that yield conclusions.
rows.anchor: برياح النفخات والإرادات سحاب العقل فروعا منتزعة من الصور الجزئية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rain signifies resulting certain knowledge; mountains in the spirit’s sky are lights of tranquility, certainty, and repose.
rows.anchor: ودق النتائج والعلوم اليقينية { يخرج من خلاله وينزل من } سماء الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hail may represent revealed realities and intuitive meanings, or the spirit’s mountains may be innate repositories of sciences, explaining why different people acquire disciplines with different ease.
rows.anchor: أو من جبال في السماء وهي معادن العلوم والكشوف وأنواعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The descending knowledge reaches spiritual faculties God wills and is turned away from veiled psychic faculties.
rows.anchor: { فيصيب به من يشاء } من القوى الروحانية { ويصرفه عمن يشاء } من القوى النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lightning is a flash of knowledge that vanishes until it becomes established; its brilliance overwhelms inner sight with bewilderment, which means increased knowledge and light.
rows.anchor: أنوار الملتمعة التي لا تلبث ولا تستقر بل تلمع وتخفى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet’s prayer to increase bewilderment is interpreted as a request for increased knowledge and light.
rows.anchor: عليه السلام: " رب زدني تحيرا " أي: علما ونورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alternates the ego’s night and spirit’s day; the lesson is to seek refuge in God through changing states until the veil lifts into the secret and spirit.
rows.anchor: فيلتجئون إلى الله في التلوينات وظلم النفس، ويلوذون بجناب الحق ومعدن النور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The senses are the constellations of the self’s sky, illuminated by the spirit’s sun and the heart’s moon, which shine by spirit-light.
rows.anchor: بروج الحواس { وجعل فيها } سراج شمس الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The alternation of ego-darkness and heart-light lets the seeker remember the forgotten primordial covenant and reflect on meanings and realities.
rows.anchor: ليل ظلمة النفس، ونهار نور القلب يعتقبان { لمن أراد أن يذكر } في نهار نور القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night is an opportunity for gratitude through worship and the acquisition of virtues and moral habits.
rows.anchor: في ليل ظلمة النفس { شكورا } بأعمال الطاعات واكتساب الأخلاق والملكات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servants of the Merciful receive this name’s outpouring because of their broad readiness; inner tranquility restrains them from rash bodily movement.
rows.anchor: المخصوصون بقبول فيض هذا الاسم لسعة الاستعداد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When fools address them, they answer peacefully without confrontation: mercy and heart-light keep them beyond the ego’s insolence and injury.
rows.anchor: يسلمون مقالهم ولا يعارضونهم لامتلائهم بالرحمة وبعد حالهم عن ظهور النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates by manifesting in forms and veiling through them, while governing all; the sun and moon’s subjection proves that no other has independent essence, quality, or act.
rows.anchor: بظهوره في مظاهرها واحتجابه بصورها مصرفا للكل بقدرته وفعله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿAzīz is the one who subdues all by power; al-Ghaffār either veils creation in His own light or covers the existence and qualities of whoever He wills.
rows.anchor: القوي الذي يقهر الكل بسطوة قهره { الغفار } الذي يسترهم بنور ذاته وصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The single self is the universal rational self, the true Adam, from whom the animal self is made as its spouse; visible forms descend from the Preserved Tablet and hidden world.
rows.anchor: هي آدم الحقيقي، أي: النفس الناطقة الكلية، التي تتشعب عنها النفوس الجزئية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The three darknesses are bodily nature, vegetative soul, and animal soul; creation unfolds in stages and produces multiplicity from unity through names, qualities, and acts.
rows.anchor: من الطبيعة الجسمانية والنفس النباتية والحيوانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone possesses real being and sovereignty, so worshipping anything else turns people toward what does not exist independently.
rows.anchor: يتصرف فيه بأفعاله { لا إله إلا هو } في الوجود { فأنى تصرفون } عن عبادته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disobedience through abandoning sincerity and looking toward another would bring the great torment of veiling, deprivation, and distance.
rows.anchor: بترك الإخلاص والنظر إلى الغير { عذاب يوم عظيم } من الاحتجاب والحرمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to worship God alone means cleansing religion of self-assertion and duality.
rows.anchor: أخص بالعبادة { مخلصا له ديني } عن شوب الأنائية والاثنينية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true losers are those attached to anything other than God and thereby veiled from the Real; they squander their souls and spiritual kin, kindred sacred substances in their spiritual world.
rows.anchor: بالحقيقة، الكاملين في الخسران، هم الواقفون مع الغير، المحجوبون عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire’s canopies above and below represent ranks of material substances surrounding those immersed in the dark well of nature.
rows.anchor: لانغمارهم في المواد الهيولانية واستقرارهم في قعر بئر الطبيعة الظلمانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Obeying desire makes it a deity, since whatever a person serves through love and obedience is that person’s god, even a stone.
rows.anchor: كل ما يعبد الإنسان بمحبته وطاعته فهو إلهه ولو كان حجرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Misguidance may follow God’s knowledge that the worshipper has lost readiness and turned downward, or refer to someone who knows religious duties yet violates them through self-love and overpowering desire, like Balaam.
rows.anchor: من زوال استعداده وانقلاب وجهه إلى الجهة السفلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase may instead describe a person with useless, extraneous knowledge that has no connection to spiritual wayfaring.
rows.anchor: أو على علم منه غير نافع، لكونه من باب الفضول لا تعلق له بالسلوك

rows.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
rows.claim: A prophetic saying warns that many learned people go astray while their knowledge does not benefit them.
rows.anchor: كم من عالم ضل ومعه علمه لا ينفعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sealing hearing and heart blocks hearing and understanding truth; a covering over sight prevents vision of divine beauty and meeting God, and none other than God can guide.
rows.anchor: بالطرد عن باب الهدى والإبعاد عن محل سماع كلام الحق وفهمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Materialists reduce life to bodily death and sensory life, attributing both to time because they are veiled from the true agent who takes souls and grants life.
rows.anchor: بالموت البدني الطبيعي { ونحيى } الحياة الجسمانية الحسية لا موت ولا حياة غيرهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reminder benefits a complete heart; alternatively, one listens in the self to the heart’s meanings and unveilings, present and receptive to its light.
rows.anchor: كامل بالغ في الترقي إلى حد كماله { أو ألقى السمع } في مقام النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Six creation days mean six directions on the outward reading; inwardly, six forms span the worlds of spirits, souls, and bodies, including substances, relations, quantities, and qualities.
rows.anchor: أي: ست جهات إن فسرنا السموات والأرض على الظاهر وإن أولنا السموات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The six thousand years mentioned in Sūrat al-Aʿrāf signify the period of the cycle of concealment.
rows.anchor: والستة الآلاف المذكورة التي هي مدة دور الخفاء على ما ذكر في (الأعراف)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience means annihilation before opponents’ words and restraining the self from displaying its acts, or at least its qualities.
rows.anchor: بالنظر إليهم بالفناء وعدم تأثير أقوالهم بالانسلاخ عن الأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praiseful glorification strips ego-qualities and manifests divine qualities and one’s latent perfections in the heart.
rows.anchor: بالتجريد عن صفات النفس حامدا لربك بالاتصاف بصفاته وإبراز كمالاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sunrise and sunset mark spirit’s witnessing and its annihilation in divine unity; night and the aftermath of prostration call for shedding successive ego and heart states after each annihilation.
rows.anchor: فإن عقيب فناء الأفعال يجب الاحتراز عن تلوين النفس وعقيب الفناء عن الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is a reminder of the primordial covenant and a provision for those lacking knowledge and practice as supplies for spiritual wayfaring.
rows.anchor: تذكيرا للعهد الأزلي في العالم القدسي { ومتاعا } للذين لا زاد لهم في السلوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stars’ settings may mean times when the sanctified Muhammadan soul connects with the Holy Spirit and receives Qur’anic verses, luminous and noble connections.
rows.anchor: أوقات اتصال النفس المحمدية المقدسة بروح القدس وهي أوقات وقوع نجوم القرآن إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, star settings are moments when the Prophet’s senses vanish from bodily perception as his secret is absorbed in the unseen, holiness, and divine unity.
rows.anchor: أوقات غيبته عن الحواس وأفول حواسه في مغرب الجسد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath is immense, but people cannot know its meaning because they lack access to this knowledge.
rows.anchor: وإنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The noble Qur’an is exalted, ancient, honorable comprehensive knowledge; its hidden book is the Prophet’s heart, where Qur’anic intellect is deposited beyond the senses except for purified angels.
rows.anchor: هو قلبه المكنون في الغيب عن الحواس وما عدا المقربين من الملائكة المطهرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hidden book may instead be the first Spirit, locus of decree and abode of the Muhammadan Spirit, or the Muhammadan Spirit itself.
rows.anchor: أو الروح الأول الذي هو محل القضاء ومأوى الروح المحمدي، بل هو هو

rows.speaker: عيسى عليه السلام
rows.claim: Jesus says knowledge is not brought down from heaven, raised from earth, or carried across seas; it is placed in hearts and appears through spiritual manners before God.
rows.anchor: لا تقولوا العلم في السماء من ينزل به، ولا في تخوم الأرض من يصعد به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only purified, immaterial spirits, cleansed of nature and material attachment, touch the hidden book.
rows.anchor: من الأرواح المجردة المطهرة عن دنس الطبائع ولوث تعلق المواد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge descends from the Lord of the worlds through the Muhammadan manifestation; people are criticized for neglecting its rights and meanings.
rows.anchor: لأن علمه ظهر على المظهر المحمدي فهو منزل منه على مدرجته منجما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse may mean that the heart’s true nourishment is denying the Qur’an because people reject knowledge outside their own; or that persistent deniers make denial their food.
rows.anchor: قوتكم القلبي ورزقكم الحقيقي تكذيبه لاحتجابكم بعلومكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For conventional, inherited faith, piety means avoiding sins and acquiring good deeds for after death, while guarding against veiling by desires; God judges acts and intentions according to each person’s intention.
rows.anchor: الإيمان الغيبي التقليدي { اتقوا الله } في اجتناب المعاصي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, realized faith requires avoiding veils caused by one’s own acts and qualities, assessing even minor deeds and traits as rejected barriers.
rows.anchor: أو آمنوا الإيمان التحقيقي واتقوا الله في الاحتجاب عنه بأفعالكم وصفاتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The realized seeker must guard against remnants of selfhood and changing states; God knows both what people do through their selves and what they do without self-assertion.
rows.anchor: واتقوا الله في البقيات والتلوينات فإن الله خبير بما تعملون بنفوسكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincere faith makes love of God outweigh love of family and wealth; otherwise attachments veil believers, waste their innate light, and lead to loss.
rows.anchor: فإن قضية الإيمان غلبة حب الله على محبة كل شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving while healthy and still needing wealth builds generosity and detachment; spending only benefits when it arises from a settled disposition of liberality.
rows.anchor: فإن الإنفاق إنما ينفع إذا كان عن ملكة السخاء وهيئة التجرد في النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At death, wealth belongs to heirs, so last-minute giving yields only regret; sincere belief recognizes death as necessary at its appointed time and cannot expect delay.
rows.anchor: فأما عند حضور الموت فالمال للوارث لا له فلا ينفعه إنفاقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows intentions, so a dying person’s promised charity is futile when it comes from miserliness and love of money rather than generosity; such wishes are lies, as another verse says.
rows.anchor: محض الكذب ومحبة العاجلة لوجود الهيئة المنافية للتصدق والصلاح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worldly possessions are inevitably transient, so their loss is no real fraud; true loss is wasting enduring capital, the light of readiness and perfection, and regret appears on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: وإنما الغبن والتغابن في إفاتة شيء لو لم يفته لبقي دائما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wasting innate readiness and its light is absolute loss; keeping readiness but failing to reach its full potential is relative loss beside the perfected person, like a lost trade.
rows.anchor: فمن أضاع استعداده ونور فطرته كان مغبونا مطلقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Imitative faith, avoiding sins, and ordinary obedience expiate sins and lead to gardens of the self according to one’s deeds.
rows.anchor: فإن آمن تقليدا واجتنب المعاصي وعمل بالطاعات يكفر عنه سيئات ذنوبه ويدخله جنات النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Verified faith, renouncing one’s qualities, and following God’s qualities expiate psychic traits and lead to gardens of the heart; witnessed faith and vigilance about existence lead to the spirit’s gardens.
rows.anchor: وإن آمن تحقيقا واجتنب صفاته وعمل بالسلوك في صفات الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True faith and vigilance about selfhood and witnessing its annihilation expiate residual ego and its shifts, leading to gardens of the divine Essence.
rows.anchor: وإن آمن إيمانا حقيقيا واتقى في آنيته ورؤية فنائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The denial of ransom rebukes escape: a person deserves punishment through the constitution of the self and is drawn to hell by affinity with it.
rows.anchor: فإنه بهيئة أجرامه استحق عذابه وبمناسبة نفسه للجحيم انجر إليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nature’s lower fire calls those turned from truth and holiness toward dark matter; natural affinity draws them into its spiritual flame, which seizes the heart, so escape is impossible.
rows.anchor: ما استدعت إلا المدبر عن الحق المعرض عن جناب القدس وعالم النور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ego is inherently a source of evil and impurity; attachment to its dark nature produces cowardice and greed, shown by despair under harm and withholding good.
rows.anchor: النفس بطبعها معدن الشر ومأوى الرجس لكونها من عالم الظلمات

rows.speaker: النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام
rows.claim: A prophetic saying calls consuming greed and ruinous cowardice a man’s worst traits.
rows.anchor: شر ما في الرجل شح هالع وجبن خالع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception is for those who strive fully, shed ego qualities, and reach direct witnessing; continuous prayer is the soul’s enduring contemplation, eclipsing all besides the witnessed.
rows.anchor: فإن المشاهدة صلاة الروح، غابوا في دوام مشاهدتهم عن النفس وصفاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The detached also relinquish outward and inward wealth, including useful true knowledge, distributing it to prepared seekers and those prevented from seeking by distractions.
rows.anchor: من العلوم النافعة والحقيقية وفرقوها على المستحق المستعد الطالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet cannot be protected from God or find refuge if God wills harm or misguidance; if he cannot control his own benefit, harm, or guidance, he cannot control theirs.
rows.anchor: وإذ لا أملك النفع والضر والهداية والغواية لنفسي فكيف أملك لكم شيئا منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His only power is to convey divine revelation, its meanings, and the rulings of truth; grammatically, the exception attaches to what he can possess.
rows.anchor: لا أملك إلا التبليغ والرسالات فهو استثناء من معمول أملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who disobey the messenger’s message reject its light and face the consuming fire of nature.
rows.anchor: منكم فلم يقبل نوره ولم يسمع ما يبلغه رسول العقل { فإن له نار } الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the small, intermediate, or great resurrection, the opponents’ weakness becomes clear beside the heart; a single person aided by God outmatches them, as cited verses affirm.
rows.anchor: يظهر ضعفهم وقلة عددهم وخمود نارهم وانطفاؤها وكلالة حدهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Innerly, religious duties are fetters, effort in seeking is a fire, resisting nature and meeting obligations instead of appetites is choking food, and ascetic struggle is painful torment.
rows.anchor: قيودا شرعية وتكاليف مانعة لهم عن أفعالها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inner resurrection, the self shakes under lights of divine disclosure and its mountains of qualities are crushed into sand.
rows.anchor: أرض النفس باستيلاء إشراقات أنوار التجليات في القلب فتقشعر وتضطرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, shackles are painful dispositions and forms, hell is natural fire, choking food is loathed nourishment, and torment comes from those fires and forms.
rows.anchor: من الهيئات المنكرة والصور المعذبة المؤذية وجحيما من نيران الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the bodily reading, death shakes the body as the soul departs; the limbs’ mountains break apart during death throes.
rows.anchor: أرض البدن بزهوق الروح وسكرات الموت وجبال الأعضاء فتتفتت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The denial that this is a warning for everyone reflects that most people are unprepared, their hearts sealed and fated for misery, so they do not heed it.
rows.anchor: فإن أكثرهم غير مستعدين مطبوع على قلوبهم محكوم بشقاوتهم فلا يتعظون به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon is the receptive, clear heart; night is ego-darkness leaving as spirit-light splits through, and dawn is that light fully illuminating the heart.
rows.anchor: القلب المستعد الصافي القابل للإنذار المتعظ به المنتفع بتذكيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hell of nature is a great calamity and warning, but it warns only receptive people who may gain virtues and approach heart and spirit, while others descend into bodily desire.
rows.anchor: بل للمستعدين القابلين الذين إن شاؤوا تقدموا باكتساب الفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human existed in divine knowledge and in reality through the eternal spirit, but was unmentioned among people while in the unseen world, unknown to those in the visible world.
rows.anchor: كان شيئا في علم الله بل في نفس الأمر لقدم روحه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God says that He Himself, without another, sent the Qur’an down to the Prophet.
rows.anchor: { إنا نحن نزلنا عليك القرآن } بذاتنا دون من عدانا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience for the decree is endurance of the self-disclosure of divine unity in annihilation amid the trial of ego’s remaining; at the descent of attributes, Lord is the Essence alone.
rows.anchor: التجلي الأحدي الذاتي في مقام الفناء مع بلاء ظهور الأنائية والبقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not obey sinners veiled by qualities and states or disbelievers veiled by acts and effects, since following them perpetuates those veils.
rows.anchor: محتجبا بالأفعال والآثار واقفا معها بأفعاله ومكسوباته عن الأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering the Lord’s name means realizing one’s own Essence as God’s greatest Name and manifesting its rights and perfections from primordial beginning to end.
rows.anchor: ذاتك الذي هو الاسم الأعظم من أسمائه بالقيام بحقوقه وإظهار كمالاته

none: source text is broken; only a trailing fragment is present

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great calamity is the light of divine unity manifesting and effacing everything.
rows.anchor: تجلى نور الوحدة الذاتية الذي يطم على كل شيء فيطمسه ويمحوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People recall their striving from primordial nature through stages and stations until annihilation, and give thanks for what they reached.
rows.anchor: سعيه في الأطوار من مبدأ فطرته إلى فنائه وسلوكه في المقامات والدرجات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hell of natural effects appears to those who see by God’s light and emerge from the veil; the veiled burn without seeing, dividing people into two groups.
rows.anchor: ممن بصر بنور الله وبرز من الحجاب لله دون العمي المحجوبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Transgressors exceed human nature’s balance toward animal or predatory ranks and prefer sensory pleasure to real life, so hell becomes their home.
rows.anchor: تعدى طور الفطرة الإنسانية وجاوز حد العدالة والشريعة إلى الرتبة البهيمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one fearing the Lord’s station ascends to heart and witnesses divine governance, restrains the self from desire through fear or awe, and reaches paradise according to rank.
rows.anchor: بالترقي إلى مقام القلب ومشاهدة قيوميته تعالى على نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge of the Hour ends with God: knowing it requires the annihilation of one’s knowledge in divine knowledge and one’s self in God’s Self.
rows.anchor: فكيف يعلمها ولا علم له ولا ذات، فمن أين أنت وغيرك من علمها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet warns only those who believe in the Hour by imitation and therefore fear it.
rows.anchor: من يخشاها } لإيمانه بها تقليدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The evening or morning may mean the setting of truth’s light in bodies or its rising from the west; witnessing resurrection through unity makes worldly existence seem only imagined.
rows.anchor: وقت غروب نور الحق في الأجساد أو وقت طلوعه من مغربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the two brief spans are bodily and spiritual worlds, concealed by sensation and intellect; passing both is described as two steps before arrival.
rows.anchor: في عالم الأجسام والاحتجاب بالحس أو في عالم الأرواح والاحتجاب بالعقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unfolded books are the faculties’ and souls’ pages containing deeds; they are folded at death when the spirit’s sun is rolled up, then opened at resurrection and return to the body.
rows.anchor: صحائف القوى والنفوس التي فيها هيئات الأعمال تطوى عند الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stripped sky signifies either animal spirit or intellect being removed.
rows.anchor: أي: الروح الحيوانية أو العقل { كشطت } أزيلت وأذهبت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell is the kindled fire of anger’s effects in nature for the veiled; paradise is the approaching bliss of divine pleasure and gentleness for the pious.
rows.anchor: أي: نار آثار الغضب والقهر في جهنم الطبيعة { سعرت } أوقدت للمحجوبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each self knows what it has brought and encountered after forgetfulness and distraction are removed.
rows.anchor: { علمت } كل { نفس } ما أحضرته ووقفت عليه بعد نسيانها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The receding stars may be planets entering their signs like animals entering dens, or souls returning to their appointed bodies.
rows.anchor: أو النفوس الرواجع إلى الأبدان الجارية الداخلة مواضعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night is the darkness of the dead body, beginning to recede as life-light appears when the soul attaches and its sun rises.
rows.anchor: أي: ليل ظلمة الجسد الميت { إذا عسعس } أي: أدبر بابتداء ذهاب ظلمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dawn is the effect of the rising spirit-sun, spreading through the body and granting it life.
rows.anchor: أثر نور طلوع تلك الشمس { إذا تنفس } وانتشر في البدن بإفادة الحياة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The noble messenger is the Spirit of Holiness, breathing into the human interior.
rows.anchor: روح القدس النافث في روع الإنسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Twilight is the remaining light of human nature after it sets in the body and mixes with ego-darkness; the oath honors its potential for acquired perfection and ascent.
rows.anchor: النورية الباقية من الفطرة الإنسانية بعد غروبها واحتجابها في أفق البدن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The body’s dark night gathers powers, instruments, and readinesses through which a person may gain knowledge, virtues, stations, gifts, and perfections.
rows.anchor: جمعه من القوى والآلا والاستعدادات التي يمكن بها اكتساب العلوم والفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon is the heart, free of the ego’s eclipse; when its light gathers and completes, it becomes whole.
rows.anchor: قمر القلب الصافي عن خسوف النفس { إذا اتسق } أي: اجتمع وتم نوره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moving from stage to stage means traversing ranked states and worlds through death, resurrection, and what follows.
rows.anchor: مراتب مجاوزة عن مراتب وطبقات وأطوار مرتبة بالموت وما بعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reminder of these states should make listeners submit to the Qur’an; those veiled from truth remain necessarily veiled from religion.
rows.anchor: بتذكير هذه الأطوار والمراتب لا يخضعون ولا ينقادون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question denies that worldly intellects can grasp why these things are honored by oath or understand their order and harmony, since fancy clouds their reason.
rows.anchor: فإن عقول أهل الدنيا المشوبة بالوهم لا تهتدي إلى ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The body is shattered by death; God appears in a form of power to those released from bodily concealment, while ordered celestial and terrestrial spirits manifest their effects in torment.
rows.anchor: ظهر في صورة القهر لمن برز عن حجاب البدن بالمفارقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell is exposed as the fire of nature and brought for those punished.
rows.anchor: برزت نار الطبيعة وأحضرت للمعذبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People then recall beliefs contrary to reality, but this reminder cannot help because entrenched belief blocks its benefit.
rows.anchor: فإن الاعتقاد الراسخ يمنع نفع هذا التذكير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sacred city is the holy realm and highest horizon where the Prophet descended; he is unrestricted there by ego qualities and habits.
rows.anchor: البلد الحرام الذي هو البلد القدسي النازل به رسول الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The father is the Holy Spirit, true father of human rational souls; the offspring is the Holy Spirit’s rational self.
rows.anchor: روح القدس الذي هو الأب الحقيقي للنفوس الإنسانية

rows.speaker: عيسى عليه السلام
rows.claim: Sayings attributed to Jesus call the Holy Spirit the heavenly father and identify the soul as what he begot.
rows.anchor: إني ذاهب إلى أبي وأبيكم السماوي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity’s hardship may mean struggle against self and desire, or inner illness and corruption: the thick liver signifies a thick veil over the heart and ignorance.
rows.anchor: غلظ الكبد الذي هو مبدأ القوة الطبيعية وفساده وحجاب القلب وفساده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bodily faculties enable people to gain perfection, see lessons, ask about what they do not know, and speak; God directs them to good and evil paths.
rows.anchor: الآلات البدنية التي يتمكن بها من اكتساب الكمال ليبصر ما يعتبر به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The difficult ascent is the ego and desire that veil the heart, crossed through discipline and struggle.
rows.anchor: عقبة النفس وهواها الحاجبة للقلب بالرياضة والمجاهدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Freeing a neck means releasing the heart, imprisoned by ego-desire, through total detachment from natural inclinations; if that fails, one practices virtues until they become natural.
rows.anchor: تخليص رقبة القلب الأسير في قيد هوى النفس وفكها عن أسرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Feeding the needy exemplifies generosity and chastity; faith is wisdom, patience is courage that depends on certainty, and compassion is justice, completing the four cardinal virtues.
rows.anchor: عدد أجناس الفضائل الأربع التي يحصل بها كمال النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The order begins with chastity and generosity, then the higher wisdom of faith, then patience which requires certainty, and ends with compassion as justice; each named quality stands for its broader virtue.
rows.anchor: بدأ بالعفة التي هي أولى الفضائل وعبر عنها بمعظم أنواعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun is the spirit and its light spreading through the body and shining upon the self.
rows.anchor: شمس الروح وضوئها المنتشرة في البدن الساطع على النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon is the heart, which follows the spirit into illumination and turns toward it; following the ego would eclipse it.
rows.anchor: قمر القلب إذا تلى الروح في التنور بها وإقباله نحوها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Day is the spirit’s dominance and full light, displaying the soul as midday displays the sun.
rows.anchor: نهار استيلاء نور الروح وقيام سلطانها واستواء نورها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ego’s darkness covers spirit; the heart arises through their mixture, since darkness lets it discern meanings that pure spirit-light cannot retain, though all three are one reality named by rank.
rows.anchor: ولولا ظلمة النفس لم تستبن المعاني في القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart is God’s throne, born from night’s ego-darkness and day’s spirit-light; its spirit-facing aspect, the fuʾād, receives realities, while its self-facing breast preserves secrets and forms meanings.
rows.anchor: فإن القلب يظهر باجتماع هذين له وجه إلى الروح يسمى الفؤاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Creator of great power and wisdom made spirit male and self female, and their union generated the heart.
rows.anchor: والقادر العظيم القدرة الحكيم الباهر الحكمة الذي { خلق الذكر } الذي هو الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human striving differs because some incline toward spiritual good under light’s dominance and others sink into evil under darkness.
rows.anchor: لانجذاب بعضكم إلى جانب الروح والتوجه إلى الخير لغلبة النورية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving and piety mean renouncing what distracts from God and purifying the self of attachment to what was relinquished.
rows.anchor: آثر الترك والتجريد فرفض ما يشغله عن الحق وتكره بالسهولة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good and highest state is the rank of perfection, affirmed through certain intellectual faith; without confidence in perfection, spiritual ascent is impossible.
rows.anchor: التي هي مرتبة الكمال بالإيمان العلمي إذ لو لم يتيقن بوجود كمال كامل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Making the easy way easy means preparing and assisting the seeker in God’s path by cutting attachments and strengthening certainty.
rows.anchor: أي فسنهيئه ونوفقه للطريقة اليسرى التي هي السلوك في الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The miser chooses love and hoarding of wealth, relying on it instead of acquiring virtue, and is thereby veiled from God.
rows.anchor: آثر محبة المال وجمعه ومنعه واستغنى به عن كسب الفضيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Denying the highest good means rejecting perfection because worldly life suffices for the person and veils the unseen and afterlife.
rows.anchor: بوجود مرتبة الكمال والفضيلة لاستغنائه بالحياة الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being prepared for hardship is divine abandonment to a downward path from human nature into the abyss of nature, with desires frustrated.
rows.anchor: بالخذلان للطريقة العسرى التي هي الانحطاط عن رتبة الفطرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wealth cannot help its owner after the person falls into hell’s well and the depth of the abyss.
rows.anchor: إذا وقع في قعر بئر جهنم وعمق الهاوية وهلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God guides people toward Himself through intellect, sense, rational and transmitted evidence, and the capacity to reason and see clearly.
rows.anchor: بنور العقل والحس والجمع بين الأدلة العقلية والسمعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God owns both lives and gives both to those who turn toward Him; one who chooses the higher necessarily receives the lower as well.
rows.anchor: نعطيهما من توجه إلينا فلا نحرم التارك المجرد عن ثواب الدنيا مع ثواب الآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cited verse illustrates that those choosing the higher receive provision from above and beneath.
rows.anchor: لأكلوا من فوقهم ومن تحت أرجلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blazing fire is the great fire spanning all levels of existence through veiling, divine wrath, and punishment by effects.
rows.anchor: نارا عظيمة يبلغ لظاها جميع مراتب الوجود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only the most wretched, lacking readiness and sharing in shirk, enters it: the one who denies God and turns away stubbornly.
rows.anchor: العديم الاستعداد، الخبيث الجوهر، المشرك بالله في المواقف الأربعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The absolutely God-fearing rejects every otherness and is absorbed in unity, escaping all levels of fire; one who stops at attributes may be forgiven yet miss the Essence’s joy and remain veiled.
rows.anchor: اتقى ما عدا الله من ذاته وصفاته وأفعاله وكل شيء من الأغيار والآثار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving wealth purifies the giver from love of rivals, attachment to otherness, attention to anything besides God, and hidden shirk.
rows.anchor: متطهرا عن لوث محبة الأنداد وتعلق الأغيار والالتفات إلى ما سوى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath is by light and darkness, the enduring foundations of human being and the two worlds; God did not abandon the Prophet in light while love remained but Essence was veiled.
rows.anchor: بالنور والظلمة الصرفة القارة على حالها الذين هما أصل الوجود الإنساني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nor did God reject him in darkness, leaving him with the cosmos without love, veiled from God and His qualities and acts.
rows.anchor: وما قلاك في عالم الظلمة والوقوف مع الكون بلا محبة وشوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The beloved who receives early disclosure may be returned to the veil after witnessing unity, intensifying longing and dissolving ego before the final unveiling, whose savor is fuller.
rows.anchor: ليشتد شوقه ويلطف سره وتذوب أنائيته بنار الشوق ثم فتح طريقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: During this concealment, Muhammad climbed mountains to seek direct sight; when his strength failed, the veil lifted and he descended.
rows.anchor: وكان صلى الله عليه وسلم في هذا الاحتجاب يصعد الجبال ليرى بنفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two hardships are veiling by creation from God and then by God from creation; their eases are disclosure of the Essence with sainthood and divinely given expansion with prophethood.
rows.anchor: أي: الاحتجاب الأول بالخلق عن الحق { يسرا } وأي يسر هو كشف الذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When finished with the journey through, with, and from God, set out on steadfastness and work to invite people.
rows.anchor: { فإذا فرغت } عن السير بالله وفي الله وعن الله { فانصب } في طريق الاستقامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Desire only God’s Essence when inviting people, without reward or other motive; otherwise the caller acts from self and deviates.
rows.anchor: لا ترغب إلا إلى ذاته دون ثواب أو غرض آخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fig is universal meaning abstracted from particulars and perceived by the heart: immaterial, precise, strengthening, and pleasurable, like fruit that is all pulp and contains seeds within it.
rows.anchor: المعاني الكلية المنتزعة عن الجزئيات التي هي مدركات القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The olive is particular, material meaning perceived by the self, prepared to help it grasp universals, like an olive with a pit.
rows.anchor: المعاني الجزئية التي هي مدركات النفس شبهها بالزيتون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sinai is the brain, the elevated bodily source of sensation and imagination; the secure city is the heart guarding universal meanings or protected from corruption.
rows.anchor: الدماغ الذي هو معدن الحس والتخيل المرتفع من أرض البدن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These oaths honor the means of human existence and perfection: universal and particular meanings, heart and self, perceivers and what they perceive.
rows.anchor: بما يحصل به كمال الإنسان ووجوده من المعاني الكلية والجزئية والقلب والنفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath prepares the claim that humanity was created with exceptional honor and rank.
rows.anchor: تعظيما للإنسان وإظهارا لشرفه وتكريما على أنه خلق الإنسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity’s best form harmonizes light and darkness, unites opposites, and mediates between two worlds, yielding balanced temperament, perfect species, and finest creature.
rows.anchor: في أعدل مزاج وأكمل نوع وأفضل مخلوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People descend to the lowest rank by becoming veiled in darkness, adopting vicious traits, and turning from virtue; they become inmates of nature’s prison and fire.
rows.anchor: لاحتجابه بالظلمة عن النور والوقوف مع رذائل الأخلاق والإعراض عن الفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers let heart-light overcome ego-darkness and gain knowledge and practical virtues, rising to high ranks in the holy world.
rows.anchor: بتغليب نور القلب على ظلمة النفس والكلي على الجزئي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their enduring reward is the gardens of hearts and selves, whose provision comes from the holy world and is free from corruption.
rows.anchor: من ثواب جنات القلوب والنفوس { غير ممنون } لاتصال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After seeing humanity’s remarkable creation spanning the highest and lowest ranks and capacities of both worlds, a person has no excuse to deny recompense.
rows.anchor: بسبب الجزاء أيها الإنسان بأن تكذب به فتكون كاذبا بعد وقوفك على هذا الخلق العجيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the wisest judge, placing a person in whichever rank He wills, rewarding the highest and punishing the lowest.
rows.anchor: فيحكم عليه بالوقف في أي مرتبة من المراتب شاء في أعلاها فيثيبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Heavy scales are real sciences, psychic virtues, and heart and spirit perfections; their owner has a satisfied, true life in gardens of attributes above gardens of deeds.
rows.anchor: من العلوم الحقيقية والفضائل النفسانية والكمالات القلبية والروحانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Light scales are evil deeds and psychic vices; their owner’s home is the abyss of bodily nature’s hell.
rows.anchor: بأن كانت من الأعمال السيئة والرذائل النفسانية { فأمه هاوية }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The abyss is a scorching fire of effects whose heat reaches the limit of burning.
rows.anchor: حقيقتها وكنه حالها إنها { نار } آثارية { حامية } بالغة إلى نهاية الإحراق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the lesser-resurrection reading, people separate from bodies at death and rush toward the light-world in confusion shaped by scattered beliefs and desires, as bodily members disintegrate like fluffed wool.
rows.anchor: الموت يوم يكون الناس بفراقهم عن الأبدان وانبعاثهم من مراقدها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rivalry in accumulation distracts people with fleeting sensory and imagined pleasures, wasting innate potential, purity, intellect, and lasting spiritual perfection for worldly boasting.
rows.anchor: اللذات الحسية والخيالية الفانية من نعيم الحياة الدنيا التي احتجبتم بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Competition over wealth, children, and ancestry can extend even to boasting about long-dead ancestors’ bones, driven by imagination and concealing illusion.
rows.anchor: من كثرة الأموال والأولاد وشرف الآباء والأجداد كل مذهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the rivalry continues until death: people spend their whole lives in it and never notice what would save them.
rows.anchor: أو حتى متم وأفنيتم عمركم فيها وما تنبهتم طول عمركم على ما هو سبب نجاتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated warning rebukes this distraction; people learn its ruin only after death, when the means of perfection are gone and lasting consequences and their fires remain.
rows.anchor: عند خراب الأبدان وكشف غطاء الأكوان حين لا ينفعكم العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Affliction falls first on prophets, then saints, then the best people in descending order of spiritual excellence.
rows.anchor: البلاء موكل بالأنبياء ثم الأولياء ثم الأمثل فالأمثل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Affliction is God’s whip, by which He drives His servants toward Himself.
rows.anchor: البلاء سوط من سياط الله يسوق به عباده إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The woe concerns people whose prayer lacks presence and sincerity; calling them “prayers” indicts them because even their finest outward deed becomes sin without those conditions.
rows.anchor: إن صلوا غفلوا عن صلاتهم لاحتجابهم عن حقيقتها بجهلهم وعدم حضورهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural form addresses a class, since the denier of judgment is treated as a generic type.
rows.anchor: وأورد على صيغة الجمع لأن المراد بالذي يكذب هو الجنس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They perform for show because they are veiled by creatures from God.
rows.anchor: يراؤون } لاحتجابهم بالخلق عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They withhold useful help, money, and goods from selfishness and narrow interests; lacking love, justice, fear, and hope, they do not assist others and will not prosper.
rows.anchor: { ويمنعون الماعون } الذي يعان به الخلق ويصرف في معونتهم
